about: KOL Watch: what is documented about accounts that promote coins, with a source for every line. Only add a record that a named investigator, a court filing or the person's own words back up, and link it. harm: dump (they or wallets tied to them sold into their own promotion, or launched a coin and sold it), insiders (a large part of the supply of a coin they launched or promoted sat with insiders, who held or sold it), undisclosed (paid to promote without saying so), collapse (the coin collapsed after their promotion, with no link to their own selling), paidloss (Pump.fun paid them callout rewards while the traders who copied their callouts lost money, by a named analyst's count; paid and lost hold the two amounts, and lost is not counted as taken from buyers). evidence: admitted, court, settled (a settlement with a regulator or in court, without admitting or denying), onchain (a named on-chain investigation), lawsuit (pending), dismissed, reported (press reports or public accusations). align: wallets (public wallets attributed by a named analyst), holds (documented holding of what they promote through a drawdown), discloses (labels paid posts). usd: the documented amount taken from buyers or held by insiders, when a source gives one. track: read their X posts and measure every coin they name.
